title: Die tschechische Stadt Pilsen
notes: PDF page 36 (code 12). Extracted 2026-07-07 using poppler's pdftotext -bbox for text (word segmentation and German spelling verified reliable — pdf.js's own text layer was found to split/misspell words on this PDF's font, e.g. "Bundesfamilienministerium" was corrupted to "Bundesfamilienministirium"/"D eutsch lands") combined with pixel-sampled color classification (renders each page at 300dpi and samples actual ink RGB at each word's exact position) rather than the PDF's internal fill-color operator sequence, which was found to desync on pages with a corrupted/remapped font and silently misattribute colors between statements — the root cause of widespread wrong answers in earlier import passes. GREEN ink = Richtig, everything else = Falsch, per user's explicit manual-answer-key convention. Pale highlight washes and red Arabic annotation text are excluded from color classification and from the statement text entirely (personal notes, not exam content). Verified letter-by-letter against source images on 6+ pages spanning the full range (2, 7, 16, 22, 29, 30, 38, 40, 42) with zero spelling or answer discrepancies remaining.

statements.text: Die tschechische Stadt Pilsen ist europäische Kulturhauptstadt 2015.
In der Nähe von St. Veit an der Glan gab es einen Autounfall mit einem Toten.
Den Film „Everest" kann man schon jetzt in allen europäischen Kinos sehen.
Nach Gewittern wird es im Nordwesten Österreichs wieder wärmer.
Wassermänner haben in dieser Woche rundum Glück in Beruf, Gesundheit und Liebe.
